description: Fetch, parse, and optionally Pydantic-typed-validate a completed Anthropic Message Batch's results (succeeded/errored/canceled/expired). A row that fails JSON parsing or schema validation is marked invalid_output=True with the raw text preserved -- never fails the whole asset. batch_id is supplied dynamically via run_config by anthropic_batch_status_sensor, or set statically for manual/backfill runs.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Output Dagster asset name. The underlying op's name is derived from this via AssetKey.to_python_identifier() — the paired anthropic_batch_status_sensor's results_asset_key field must equal this value so its RunRequest.run_config addresses the correct op.

batch_id.label: Batch ID
batch_id.description: Static batch_id for manual/backfill runs. Overridden at runtime by the `batch_id` op config value supplied by anthropic_batch_status_sensor's RunRequest.

output_schema.label: Output Schema
output_schema.description: Dotted path 'module.path:ClassName' to a Pydantic model used to validate/parse each succeeded row's raw_output as JSON. A row that fails to parse or validate is marked invalid_output=True (raw_output is kept, typed columns left null) rather than failing the whole asset.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the Anthropic API key

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — list of team names or email addresses, e.g. ['team:analytics', 'user@company.com']

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags to apply to the asset, e.g. {'domain': 'finance', 'tier': 'gold'}

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog, e.g. ['anthropic', 'python']. Auto-inferred from component name if not set.

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.
